notes.title: New title - Mindful Dead / Chapter1(Free)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=N1U1y9cZ6pY;full][/previewyoutube]
Mindful Dead / Free Role-playing game

Category - Dark Fantasy RPG
Platform - PC only (Windows, Macintosh)
Release date - November​ 2019
No.of Players - Single
Website - https://radicalhyena.com/mindfuldead

Thanks for watching. This is a video game that I'm developing these days. And it's free! 
You'll be able to check and download the game from my website.

notes.title: Koikoi Update ver 1.0.1
notes.notes:
ver 1.0.1 (2018 July 22nd)
-Fixed the event error.
If you already went to Bigrobin and met the dog's event that is in the upper left corner's road (in the huge map) before the update, please DO NOT go back to the ruined church's road in the forest. It causes freezing.
When you got "3 papers" during the journey, you can go back to the home.
-Fixed some mistranslations.
